description: Retrieve a read-only 4-step Nomos rollout guide (X-Ray baseline, stealth Branch Guard, CI SARIF, and isolated Git worktrees) tailored to repository LOC, languages, and air-gap constraints. Example: languages=['go','typescript'], repo_loc=120000 returns a phased brownfield guide. Use when planning rollout steps for a team or monorepo. Do NOT use when previewing raw nomos.yaml and CI workflow templates (use scaffold_nomos_config instead).
